evidence: Full indradhanus gives rainbow and Pali indradhanu, Prakrit imdadhanu/imdahanu. The selected eastern Indra-dhanu forms preserve both lexical elements with regional cluster simplification, vowel variation, and source d/dh or retroflex transcription retained. Learned or cross-IA transmission remains qualified.

Full indradhanus explicitly gives Khowar dronhanu, with alternative explanations: crossing with dron < drona or descent from proposed dronadhanuka. The selected drohan/drnhanu/dronhanu belong to this published rainbow comparison; retain both alternatives and do not claim uncomplicated inheritance from indradhanus.

Full indradhanus gives Palula izdran/izran with expressly unexplained z/zh, Bshk idran, and Tor inhan. These support selected ziran/drani and hinan/hidan/hirdan/hedon rainbow forms, preserving survey metathesis, rhotic loss or h-placement as qualified local developments. The link asserts the comparative family, not a proven regular sound derivation; opaque higdān and mixed responses excluded.

Turner addendum 14295 to indradhanus explicitly gives Shina bizon rainbow crossed with vidhra. The selected neighbouring Indus Kohistani/Chilisso bizon/bizon/bizvan forms closely match this published crossed family. Preserve vowel/sibilant differences and the crossing qualification; inheritance versus cross-IA transmission remains unresolved, and no direct Shina donor is asserted.
